noflyzone.message.takeoff_denied: Here, rough magic clips thy wings of flight!
noflyzone.message.glide_cut: A spell most foul doth bind thy wings to earth!
noflyzone.message.riptide_denied: By Prospero's art, the very air doth deny thee passage!
noflyzone.message.boost_denied: Thy spark doth fail! No fire within thee now!
noflyzone.message.momentum_cut: Thou shalt not reach thy yonder window, bound as thou art!
noflyzone.message.shot_down: Thus do the slings and arrows strike thee down!
noflyzone.mode.zero-momentum: Suspended 'tween earth and sky; a gentle fall awaits
noflyzone.mode.no-glide: The tempest rages — down must thou descend
noflyzone.mode.damage: Thy hubris wounds thee — pride before the fall
